name: Tremor Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sends a low shudder of earth force through the target's footing.

name: Grounded Brace
description: Sink the weight into the ground and let it carry a blow away through the feet.

name: Heavy Tread
description: Step so heavily that the ground answers each footfall and pushes the stride onward.

name: Quaking Fist
description: Hit the target so hard that the ground quakes and its balance is lost.

name: Rooted Crush
description: Press down with a weight that seems to come from the earth itself and pins the target.

name: Earthen Vigor
description: Draw strength up from the ground into the user or an ally through the soles of the feet.

name: Seismic Blow
description: Drive a fist into the ground so the shock runs out and strikes every target near.

name: Foundation Rebuke
description: Take a blow upon a stance as fixed as a foundation and return the whole force.

name: Tectonic Hammer
description: Bring down a fist weighted with the slow force of the earth to split guard and ground alike.

name: Worldweight
description: streams: Strength + Earth; join the body's mass to the earth's own and bring the whole of it down in one blow.

name: Spark Fist
description: Throw a fist that sheds a crack of bolt force as it lands on the target.

name: Charged Guard
description: Hold the arms charged with bolt force so that the shock of a blow is thrown back as a jolt.

name: Quick Tread
description: Spring forward with a jolt of charged force through the legs and land with full weight.

name: Static Draw
description: Build a bright charge along the arms until the muscles twitch with ready strength.

name: Arc Hammer
description: Swing a charged fist in an arc that leaves a streak of bolt force along the blow.

name: Crackling Grip
description: Seize the target with a charged hand whose shocks lock the muscles of the gripped limb.

name: Shock Press
description: Press the palm to the target and release a jolt that stiffens its arms and breath.

name: Static Purge
description: Send a sharp charge through the body to jolt poison or numbness out of the user or an ally.

name: Boltfall Crush
description: Bring a fist down with the sudden weight of a falling bolt that crushes the guard.

name: Arc Rebuke
description: Turn a blow aside and return it along an arc of charged force.

name: Bolt Colossus
description: Stand as a charged colossus and bring the fist down with a weight and shock that bind the target.

name: Voltfist
description: streams: Strength + Lightning; strike with a fist in which crushing weight and a full bolt land in one instant.

name: Coal Knuckle
description: Strike with a fist glowing like a coal that sears as it lands.

name: Forge Guard
description: Hold arms hot as a kiln so that blows and grasping hands recoil from the heat.

name: Cinder Pace
description: Step on a bed of rising heat that lifts each stride and leaves a scorched mark.

name: Blazing Hammer
description: Bring down a fist as hot as a smith's hammer fresh from the coals.

name: Scorch Press
description: Press a burning palm to the target until pain and weight together hold it down.

name: Hearth Vigor
description: Pass the steady warmth of the Core to an ally and the ally's muscles swell with strength.

name: Cinder Purge
description: Burn poison or taint out of the user or an ally with a clean heat that does no harm.

name: Furnace Crush
description: Seize the target in a furnace-hot grip and crush it between burning hands.

name: Smolder Rebuke
description: Turn a blow aside with a burning forearm and return a fist wreathed in heat.

name: Pyre Colossus
description: Stand as a colossus wreathed in flame and bring a burning fist down on the front.

name: Molten Might
description: streams: Strength + Fire; strike with a fist both heavy and white with heat so it crushes and melts at once.

name: Vital Fist
description: Throw a fist driven by a surge of life force in the arm that lends it extra weight.

name: Vital Guard
description: Hold a guard whose living muscle rebounds from each blow before the bone can suffer.

name: Living Pace
description: Step with the springing life of a body that does not tire under its own weight.

name: Vital Draw
description: Draw on the body's life force to lift strength without wearing the muscle down.

name: Quickened Hammer
description: Bring a hammer blow down with the quickness of living muscle at its freshest.

name: Vital Press
description: Press down on the target with weight that does not tire and does not slacken.

name: Vital Infusion
description: Lay a hand on an ally and pour life force into its muscle until it stands stronger.

name: Vital Cleanse
description: Drive tainted blood out of the user or an ally with surging life force and clear its veins.

name: Living Rebuke
description: Turn a blow on springing muscle and return it with the weight of a body that heals as it fights.

name: Growth Crush
description: Swell the muscles of the arm to twice their size for a single crushing stroke.

name: Vital Ruin
description: Ruin the target's guard with a blow that grows heavier as the user's life force surges.

name: Vigorous Colossus
description: Stand as a colossus full of life force and bring a binding fist down on the target.

name: Vitality Unbound
description: streams: Strength + Life; let life force pour through the frame until every limb of the user or an ally is at full strength.

name: Evergrowing Might
description: streams: Strength + Life; strike with a fist whose weight grows as the user's body renews itself.
